title: Settings page
description: A multi-section account settings screen with clear save boundaries.
useWhen: Users need to manage several account settings.
avoidWhen: The page contains only one short form.
constraints: Use one primary action per form section.
Do not place destructive actions beside the primary save action.
Keep settings grouped by user intent.
composition: Inline feedback near the affected section

title: Search/results page
description: A query-first screen that makes result counts, filters, and zero results explicit.
useWhen: Users need to find a record or content item by query.
avoidWhen: There are only a handful of fixed navigation destinations.
constraints: Keep the query visible after submission.
Explain zero results and offer a useful next action.

title: CRUD table page
description: A practical create, read, update, delete page for a collection of records.
useWhen: Users manage a comparable collection with row-level actions.
avoidWhen: Records are primarily narrative or need a bespoke visual comparison.
constraints: Make create the page-level primary action.
Confirm destructive row actions and preserve context.

title: Detail page
description: A focused record view with summary, grouped fields, and contextual actions.
useWhen: Users need to understand one record before acting on it.
avoidWhen: Users mainly compare many records at once.
constraints: Put the record identity and status above secondary fields.
Keep destructive actions visually and spatially separate.

title: Empty state
description: A small page-level empty state for a collection or first-run workflow.
useWhen: A collection is valid but currently contains no records.
avoidWhen: The collection request failed or is still loading.
constraints: Say what is empty and how to create the first item.
Do not use an empty state to hide a loading or error condition.

title: Application shell
description: A reusable navigation frame for a small local application or internal tool.
useWhen: Several screens share a persistent navigation and content frame.
avoidWhen: A single screen needs no persistent navigation.
constraints: Keep the rail useful at narrow widths.
Use native links inside the nav slot.
